title: CTS Corporation Announces Completion of the Acquisition of Millar Holdings
summary: CTS Corporation Announces Completion of the Acquisition of Millar Holdings ...
body_markdown:
LISLE, Ill., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CTS Corporation (NYSE: CTS) today announced that it has completed the acquisition of Millar Holdings, Inc. (“Millar”) for $50 million, net of cash acquired and debt assumed, with additional contingent consideration payable subject to the achievement of specified financial performance targets. Millar specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced pressure sensing technologies for medical devices, life sciences, and industrial applications. The acquisition strengthens CTS’s position in advanced sensing technologies and expands its presence in diversified end markets.


“We are excited to welcome the Millar team to CTS,” said Pratik Trivedi, President and Chief Executive Officer of CTS Corporation. “Millar represents a highly strategic addition to our portfolio, expanding our presence in medical sensing while adding differentiated technology, talented employees, and strong customer relationships. We believe the combination will enhance our ability to deliver innovative sensing solutions to customers worldwide and create long-term value for our shareholders.”


Tim Daugherty, Chief Executive Officer of Millar, added, “Joining CTS marks an exciting new chapter for Millar and an incredible opportunity to build on everything our team has accomplished over the past 55-plus years. We've always been passionate about pushing the boundaries of sensor technology and helping our customers bring innovative solutions to life. With CTS's global reach, complementary technologies, and engineering expertise, we're positioned to accelerate innovation, expand our capabilities, and create even greater value for the customers and markets we serve.”


**About CTS Corporation**


CTS is a leading designer and manufacturer of products that Sense, Connect, and Move. The Company manufactures sensors, connectivity components, and actuators for applications in the aerospace and defense, industrial, medical, and transportation markets. CTS reported sales of approximately $564 million for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026.
